title: Protocols for endothelial cell isolation from mouse tissues: kidney, spleen, and testis
protocol: Right before isolation, prepare kidney digestion buffer containing HBSS (Ca2+, Mg2+).
Prepare PBS-based glomeruli digestion buffer.
Perform transcardial perfusion via the left ventricle with ice-cold PBS at a rate of 1 mL/min for 5 minutes.
Harvest kidneys and store in ice-cold HBSS.
Cut kidneys into small pieces (approx. 1-2 mm²) using a scalpel blade.
Transfer kidney pieces to a petri dish containing around 5 mL kidney digestion buffer.
Fill up the conical tube with kidney digestion buffer to reach the required volume.
Incubate the sample in digestion buffer for 40 minutes at 37°C.
Shake the tube vigorously by hand every 10 minutes.
Add an equal volume of cold HBSS to stop the digestion.
Filter cell suspension through a 70 μm cell strainer.
Wash the conical tube and the strainer once with 5-10 mL of cold HBSS.
Split the flow-through into two equal fractions.
Filter each fraction using a 40 μm cell strainer.
Wash the glomeruli on the cell strainers extensively (15 times) with 6 mL of cold HBSS.
Transfer the 40 μm cell strainers to a Petri dish.
Collect glomeruli in a 15 mL conical tube by washing the interior of the strainers and collecting from the top of the strainers with 200 μL HBSS each time for a minimum of 10 times.
If necessary, cut out the mesh from cell strainers and immerse filter meshes in 1 ml HBSS for additional washing.
Transfer any additional cell suspension to a 15 mL conical tube.
Centrifuge the glomeruli at 300 g for 5 min, then remove the supernatant.
Resuspend the pellet in 1 ml of HBSS to inspect the purity of the glomerular suspension under a microscope.
Repeat centrifugation at 300 g for 5 min after inspection.
Reconstitute and preheat glomeruli digestion buffer in a water bath at 37°C for 5 minutes.
Incubate the sample in a 37°C water bath for precisely 23 minutes, resuspending every 5 minutes by pipetting up and down with a 1 ml tip.
Neutralize trypsin activity by adding 2 ml of trypsin neutralization solution and dilute up to 10 ml with HBSS.
Centrifuge the cell suspension at 400 g for 5 min, then remove the supernatant.
Resuspend the pellet in 1 ml HBSS.
Continue with FACS staining.
Resuspend the pellet in an appropriate amount of Wash Buffer 1 and add the appropriate volume of CD31 MicroBeads according to the manufacturer's instructions.
Resuspend cells in 90 μL of Wash Buffer 1.
Determine the cell number.
For up to 1×10^7 total cells, add 10 μL of CD31 MicroBeads.
Mix and incubate for 15 min at 4°C.
Wash cells by adding 3 mL of Wash Buffer 2.
Centrifuge at 300 g for 5 min at 4°C.
Remove the supernatant.
Resuspend the pellet in 3 mL of Wash Buffer 2.
Apply the cell suspension onto the prepared LS column through a 40 μm cell strainer.
Wash the LS column 3 times with 3 mL Wash Buffer 2.
Add buffer to the column once the reservoir is empty each time during washing.
Remove the LS column from the separator and place it onto a new 15 mL conical collection tube.
Pipet 5 mL Wash Buffer 1 onto the LS column.
Immediately flush out the fraction containing magnetically labeled cells by firmly applying the plunger.
Continue with FACS staining.
Centrifuge the glomerular and renal parenchymal cell suspensions at 300 g for 5 min.
Remove the supernatant from the pellets.
Resuspend the glomerular cell pellet in 0.5 ml wash buffer containing CD102 antibody, CD73 antibody, CD45 antibody, and viability dye.
Resuspend the renal parenchyma cell pellet in 0.5 ml wash buffer containing CD102 antibody and CD31 antibody.
Stain cells for 30 min at 4°C in the dark.
Add 3 mL of Wash Buffer 1 and centrifuge stained cells at 300 g for 5 min at 4°C.
Remove the supernatant from the stained cells.
Resuspend pellets in Wash Buffer 1.
Proceed with FACS analysis.
Sort viable, CD45-, CD73-, CD102+ glomerular ECs to collection tubes containing Wash Buffer 2.
Sort viable, CD45-, CD31+ renal parenchyma ECs to collection tubes containing collection medium (10% (v/v) FBS in PBS).
Prepare spleen digestion buffer right before isolation.
Perform transcardial perfusion via the left ventricle with ice-cold PBS at a rate of 1 mL/minute for 5 minutes.
Grind the harvested spleens in a Petri dish on ice with the rough end of a syringe plunger rod in 5 mL of spleen digestion buffer per 3 spleens.
Transfer spleens with digestion buffer to a 50 mL conical tube.
Incubate sample in digestion buffer in a 37°C water bath for 15 min.
Shake the tube by hand every 5 min for faster tissue dissociation.
Stop the reaction with 12.5 mL of cold Wash Buffer 2.
Filter the sample first through a 100 μm cell strainer and then through a 40 μm cell strainer.
Centrifuge the cell suspension at 300 g for 7 min.
Remove the supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 5 mL of Wash Buffer 2.
Centrifuge the cell suspension at 300 g for 5 min, remove the supernatant.
Resuspend the pellet in 1.5 mL of Wash Buffer 1.
Gently apply the cell suspension in a 15 mL conical tube filled with 10 mL of Ficoll and centrifuge at 700 g for 30 min.
Critical: Deceleration of the centrifuge should be performed with low break (SLOW option), or no break if the slow option is not available on the centrifuge, to not disturb the gradient.
After centrifugation, collect the Ficoll part and dilute it up to 50 mL with Wash Buffer 1.
Note: A 5 mL pipette can be used for collecting the Ficoll part.
Centrifuge at 300 g for 10 min, remove the supernatant.
Wash the pellet a second time with 20 mL of Wash Buffer 1 and centrifuge at 300 g for 5 min.
Remove the supernatant.
Resuspend the pellet in an appropriate amount of Wash Buffer 1.
Add the appropriate volume of CD45 MicroBeads to the suspension according to the manufacturer's instructions.
Mix well.
Incubate for 15 min at 4°C.
Wash the cells by adding 3 mL of Wash Buffer 2.
Centrifuge at 300 g for 5 min at 4°C.
Prepare collection tubes and LD columns according to the manufacturer's instructions.
Place the column in the suitable magnetic separator.
Rinse the column with 3 mL of Wash Buffer.
Remove the supernatant from the pellet.
Resuspend the pellet in 2 mL of Wash Buffer 2.
Apply 2 mL of sample suspension onto one LD column through a 40 μm cell strainer.
Collect unlabeled cells (the eluent) in a 15 mL conical tube and keep on ice during collection.
Wash the LD column twice with 1 mL Wash Buffer 2, adding buffer each time once the column reservoir is empty.
Collect the eluent to the conical tube from step #8e; this fraction contains ECs.
Centrifuge the total eluent (CD45-negative fraction) at 300 g for 5 min.
Remove the supernatant from the centrifuged sample.
Resuspend the pellet in an appropriate amount of Wash Buffer 1 according to manufacturer's instructions.
Add the appropriate volume of CD31 MicroBeads to the suspension as per manufacturer's guidelines.
Resuspend cells in 90 μL of Wash Buffer 1.
Determine the cell number.
For up to 1×10^7 total cells, add 10 μL of CD31 MicroBeads to the resuspended cells.
Mix and incubate for 15 min at 4°C.
Wash the cells by adding 3 mL of Wash Buffer 2.
Centrifuge at 300 g for 5 min at 4°C.
Remove supernatant and resuspend pellet in 3 mL of Wash Buffer 2.
Apply the cell suspension onto the prepared LS column through a 40 μm cell strainer to remove potential cell aggregates.
Wash the LS column 3 times with 3 mL Wash Buffer 2, adding buffer each time once the column reservoir is empty.
Pipette 5 mL Wash Buffer 1 onto the LS column.
Firmly apply the plunger supplied with the column to flush out the fraction containing the magnetically labeled cells (CD31-positive fraction).
Prepare unstained cell control for flow cytometry analysis.
Prepare viability control for flow cytometry analysis.
Prepare Fluorescence Minus One (FMO) control for flow cytometry analysis.
Optional: Prepare isotype controls for flow cytometry analysis.
Prepare compensation controls for each fluorophore for proper set up of the cytometer.
Centrifuge the cell suspension at 300 g for 5 min.
Remove the supernatant.
Resuspend the pellet in 0.5 mL Wash Buffer 1-based staining solution containing CD11b Monoclonal Antibody (M1/70).
Stain the cells for 30 min at 4°C in the dark.
Add 3 ml of Wash Buffer 1 and centrifuge the stained cells at 300 g for 5 min at 4°C.
Remove the supernatant.
Resuspend the pellet in Wash Buffer 1.
Sort viable, CD45- & CD11b-, CD31+ cells to collection tubes.
Perform transcardial perfusion via the left ventricle with ice-cold PBS at a rate of 1 mL/minute for 5 minutes before dissecting the testis.
Prepare testis digestion buffer containing HBSS (Ca²⁺, Mg²⁺) and 0.2% collagenase I (Sigma-Aldrich), along with 7.5 μg/mL DNase I.
Store the freshly prepared testis digestion buffer at 4°C until needed.
Prepare PBS-based Wash Buffer 2 and store it at 4°C until needed.
Collect testis and remove the epididymis.
Cut testis into small pieces (1 mm³) with two scalpel blades.
Transfer cut testis pieces to a 50 mL conical tube containing testis digestion buffer.
Incubate sample in digestion buffer at 37°C for 20 min.
Shake the tube vigorously by hand every 5 min during incubation.
Stop reaction by adding 25 mL of Wash Buffer 2.
Filter the sample first through a 100 μm cell strainer and then a 40 μm cell strainer.
Centrifuge the cell suspension at 300 g for 7 min.
Remove the supernatant and resuspend the pellet in 10 mL of Wash Buffer 2.
Centrifuge cell suspension at 300 g for 5 min.
Resuspend the pellet in an appropriate amount of Wash Buffer 1.
Add the appropriate volume of CD31 MicroBeads to the suspension according to the manufacturer's instructions.
Resuspend cells in 90 μL of Wash Buffer 1.
Determine the cell number.
Add 10 μL of CD31 MicroBeads for up to 1×10^7 total cells.
Mix and incubate for 15 min at 4°C.
Wash the cells by adding 3 mL of Wash Buffer 2.
Centrifuge at 300 g for 5 min at 4°C.
Remove the supernatant.
Resuspend the pellet in 3 mL of Wash Buffer 2.
Apply the cell suspension onto the prepared LS column through a 40 μm cell strainer.
Wash the LS column 3 times with 3 mL Wash Buffer 2.
Remove the LS column from the separator and place it onto a new 15 mL conical collection tube.
Pipette 5 mL Wash Buffer 1 onto the LS column.
Firmly apply the plunger to flush out the fraction containing the magnetically labeled cells (CD31-positive fraction).
Prepare all required controls for flow cytometry analysis beforehand, including unstained cell control, viability control, Fluorescence Minus One control, isotype controls, and compensation controls.
Centrifuge the cell suspension at 300 g for 5 min, remove the supernatant.
Resuspend the pellet in 0.5 mL Wash Buffer 1-based staining solution containing CD31 (PECAM-1) Monoclonal Antibody, CD45 Monoclonal Antibody, and Viability Dye.
Stain the cells for 30 min at 4°C in the dark.
Add 3 mL of Wash Buffer 1 and centrifuge the stained cells at 300 g for 5 min at 4°C, remove the supernatant.
Resuspend the pellet in Wash Buffer 1 and proceed with FACS.
Sort viable, CD45-, CD31+ cells to collection tubes.
